requirements.title: Coindexed named objects are named scalar coarray variables selected by an image selector
requirements.definition: A coindexed-named-object is formed from a named scalar coarray variable followed by an image selector. The coarray object's corank, cobounds, image index, team, STAT, NOTIFY, TEAM and TEAM_NUMBER details are not defined here; they remain owned by the data-ref/part-ref and image-selector rules in 9.4.2 and 9.6.

pending.named-coarray-variable: PENDING coarray positive-control source: declare a named scalar INTEGER coarray x[*], define x on image 1 with a small literal, and use x[1] where a designator value is required. The oracle is the literal value from the selected named coarray under a qualified multi-image profile; image-selector semantics stay 9.6-owned.
pending.scalar-object: PENDING source/control pair contrasting a scalar coarray x[*] used as x[1] with an array coarray a(2)[*] that requires an element subscript before the image selector under the array-element owner. The non-vacuous repaired control observes distinct element literals rather than a whole-array value.
pending.image-selector-follows-name: PENDING diagnostic/control source: with x declared as a scalar coarray, omit or misplace the image selector in a context requiring a coindexed named object, then repair only to x[1]. The repaired source observes a defined literal from image 1; the invalid source is not executed.

requirements.title: A coindexed named object has data-ref syntax
requirements.definition: The syntactic form coindexed-named-object is data-ref. C921 then narrows that data-ref to one part-ref containing an image selector whose part-name is a scalar coarray name; arbitrary data-ref chains are not admitted by R914 alone as conforming coindexed named objects.

pending.data-ref-form: PENDING coarray positive-control source: use a single-part data-ref x[1] where x is a named scalar coarray, with x defined to a literal on image 1. The observed literal proves the R914 data-ref form participates in a designator rather than being a token-only acceptance.
pending.data-ref-chain-boundary: PENDING diagnostic/control source: attempt a chained data-ref such as obj%x[1] in a context requiring coindexed-named-object, then repair to the named coarray x[1] or classify the chain under structure-component/coindexed-object owners. The repaired literal control isolates that C921, not R914, supplies the one-part boundary.

requirements.title: A coindexed named object has exactly one image-selected scalar coarray part
requirements.definition: For an R914 coindexed-named-object, the data-ref shall contain exactly one part-ref. That part-ref shall contain an image-selector, and its part-name shall be the name of a scalar coarray. The image-selector's cosubscripts, optional specifiers, team and image-index validity are dependencies from 9.6 rather than separate 9.4.3 ownership.

pending.exactly-one-part-ref: PENDING diagnostic/control source: form a two-part data-ref with an image selector in a context requiring coindexed-named-object, then repair to a single named scalar coarray x[1]. The repaired program observes a literal assigned to x on image 1, proving the removed part-ref is material.
pending.image-selector-required: PENDING diagnostic/control source: use scalar coarray name x without [1] where a coindexed-named-object is required, then repair by adding only the image selector. The valid control reads a distinct literal from the selected image.
pending.scalar-coarray-part-name: PENDING positive-control source: declare INTEGER :: x[*] and use x[1] with one cosubscript. The declaration makes x scalar and coarray; a defined literal on image 1 is the independent oracle.
pending.noncoarray-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source: declare scalar noncoarray y and attempt y[1]; repair by adding codimension to make y a scalar coarray and observe a literal from image 1. The source otherwise keeps the same type and value setup.
pending.array-coarray-without-element-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source: declare INTEGER :: a(2)[*] and attempt a[1] as a coindexed named object; repair to an element form a(2)[1] under the array-element owner or to a separate scalar coarray x[1]. Distinct element literals make the scalar requirement non-vacuous.

review_rationale: Independent source review in doc/source_audits/batch_089.json reads all three original 9.4.3 units and their six fine units, verifies the census hashes and confirms that C921 keeps three separate conditions on the R914 data-ref: exactly one part-ref, an image-selector in that part-ref, and a part-name naming a scalar coarray. The p1 characterization of a coindexed named object as a named scalar coarray variable followed by an image selector is recorded without absorbing the image-selector semantics owned by 9.6 or the part-ref chain owned by the registered 9.4.2 catalogue. All ten facets remain pending source plans; no case, execution, oracle or fixture approval is created.
